🔥 stackyard | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing and cleaning up multiple SDKs and toolchains on a developer's machine to optimize disk space and fix environment configuration issues.
✨ Key Features: • Finds all installed SDKs and toolchains (Flutter, Node.js, Android SDK, Xcode, Java, Python, .NET, Gradle, etc.) • Shows which projects use each SDK version
📖 Summary: Stackyard is a free, open-source desktop application for Windows and macOS that helps developers manage their software development kits (SDKs) and toolchains. It identifies all installed SDKs, tracks which projects use them, and provides one-click solutions to fix broken setups and free up disk space by removing unused versions.
